language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Hi, I'm Cindy. I'm on vacation with my family. We flew to this beautiful island in the Bermuda Triangle. There's so much mystery about this place, and lots of rumours about all the strange things that happen here.

But, the mystery that I'm really excited about uncovering is where all these beautiful clouds come from. I know it has to do with water somehow. We've been experimenting with the different states of water in school, so I intend to get to the bottom of things while I'm here.
I hear it has something to do with temperature, humidity, and the dew point.
Can you help Cindy get to the bottom of this?

Did you know water is everywhere? You don't always see it, because it can take three different forms: solid, liquid and gas. When water changes from one form to another, we have a word for it. Can you find the right words?

Have you ever heard about the dew point? This is the temperature point where water evaporates and condenses at the same time. Can you help me answer these questions?
